newsitem.title: USA: Houston Exploration battles US Gulf blowout.
newsitem.headline: Houston Exploration battles US Gulf blowout.

text.p: Houston Exploration Co on Monday said a blowout over the weekend delayed completion on a Gulf of Mexico natural gas well expected to flow at 6 million to 8 million cubic feet per day.

A company spokesman told Reuters a neighboring production platform handling 11 million to 12 million cubic feet per day was unaffected by the blowout on well C1 in East Cameron Blocks 82/83 about 30 miles off the coast of Louisiana.
"We had anticipated this well coming on over the weekend," the spokesman said.
There was no fire or pollution from the blowout, and crews working on the rig were evacuated safely.
Crews from Wild Well Control were on the scene working to cap the blowout, the Houston Exploration spokesman said.
